title: Dispatch Charge Table for Trouble Calls under Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
When a crew dispatched on a trouble report for an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account finds the cause on the member's side of the meter, the call is charged at the figure for the dispatch period, subject to the courtesy allowance per service account in a rolling 12 months.

| Term | R | RS | FH | GS-1 | GS-3 | IR | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member-side trouble call, crew dispatched during business hours | $65.00 | $65.00 | $65.00 | $65.00 | $65.00 | $65.00 | $95.00 |
| Member-side trouble call, crew dispatched outside business hours | $135.00 | $135.00 | $135.00 | $135.00 | $135.00 | $135.00 | $195.00 |
| Member-side trouble calls not charged per service account in a rolling 12 months | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |

Column key: R is Schedule R Residential Service; RS is Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service; FH is Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; GS-1 is Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; GS-3 is Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service; IR is Schedule IR Irrigation Service; LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

### Reading the table

- On Schedules R, RS, FH, GS-1, GS-3 and IR a member-side call costs $65.00 during business hours and $135.00 outside them, and 1 member-side call per rolling 12 months is not charged.
- On Schedule LP the figures are $95.00 and $195.00, with no courtesy allowance (0).

### Hypothetical example

A Schedule FH member's crew call at 21:15 (outside business hours, hypothetical) is found member-side. Where the courtesy allowance has already been used within the rolling 12 months, the call is billed $135.00.
